issues.failure_explanation: Under (S2) the functions Phi_n(.,A) are only assumed to converge to dist(.,spec(A)) from above, uniformly on compact sets; no equicontinuity in z is imposed. The grid G_{1/n_2,n_1} in (S2_cover_alg) grows with n_1, and the radius at a center w uses Phi_{n_1}(w,A), whose convergence is uncontrolled on the diagonal |w| approximately n_1. Counterexample: spec(A)={0}, n_2=1, Phi_n(z,A)=|z|+e^{2|z|} 1[n<=|z|] (after the paper's successive-minima reduction this is non-increasing in n, bounded below by dist(.,spec(A)), and converges to dist(.,spec(A)) uniformly on compacts, so (S2) holds). At stage n_1 the newly added center w=n_1 has radius floor(Phi_{n_1}(n_1,A)) >= e^{2n_1}, and its ball contains [-n_1,n_1]; hence Gamma_{1,n_1}^spec(A)=emptyset for all n_1, the limit is emptyset, and spec(A)={0} is not contained in it, refuting both stated inclusions and the displayed limit formula in the proof (which yields {0}). A parity variant of the bump makes Gamma_{1,n_1}^spec(A) alternate between emptyset and {0}, so it is not eventually constant either. The proof's justification only shows that points outside [-L,L] are removed; it never analyzes the effect of balls from far centers on [-L,L] at finite n_1, silently relying on a false premise. The same gap invalidates the monotonicity claim reused in fractal_dim_final.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restrict (S2) (or the lemma) to functions Phi_n that are equicontinuous in z, e.g. 1-Lipschitz, and add a nesting argument: for grid centers w>=L, floor-rounding plus 1-Lipschitz continuity gives w - \widehat{Phi}_{n_1}(n_2;w,A) >= L - \widehat{Phi}_{n_1}(n_2;L,A), so balls from far centers are trapped inside the ball at L and the cover is determined by the finitely many centers in G_{1/n_2,L}, whose radii are eventually constant; this restores eventual constancy, the limit formula, and both inclusions. The hypothesis is free for the paper: the functions built in thm:added-1 are 1-Lipschitz in z (smallest singular values are 1-Lipschitz), (S1)-induced functions dist(z,Gamma_n^spec)+E_n^spec are 1-Lipschitz, and the radii can alternatively be Lipschitz-regularized on the grid inside the construction. All advertised classifications survive.
issues.overall_effect: Every classification proved under (S2) rests on this lemma: thm_warm_up2 (whose proof calls the eventual constancy crucial), cor_assumII_extra_lims, and fractal_dim_final are unproven as stated, and with them the (S2) column of Table SCI_tab and the theoretical foundation of the two-dimensional computations in sec:examples2.
issues.title: Covering lemma under (S2) is false without equicontinuity of the functions Phi_n
issues.why_classification: The lemma is false as stated (an explicit counterexample satisfies its hypotheses), so the repair is more than routine: it needs a new hypothesis plus a new contained nesting argument, or a modified radius construction. It is not serious because that contained repair preserves every classification, rate, and application in the paper.

This means that all of the classifications in \cref{thm_warm_up} carry through with the penalty of an additional limit.

issues.failure_explanation: Under (S2), computing f(Gamma_{n_2}^spec(A)) itself requires the inner limit n_1 -> infinity of lem:cover1, which is uncontrolled (eventually constant but with unknown stabilization time). Even with full error control on the outer limit f(Gamma_{n_2}^spec(A)) -> f(spec(A)), the resulting tower has height two with only the final limit controlled, which by the paper's own definition (height k gives Delta_{k+1}^alpha) is Delta_3^A, not Delta_2^A (height at most 1). The justification 'carry through with the penalty of an additional limit' applied to the Delta_1^A clause of thm_warm_up therefore yields Delta_3^A; asserting Delta_2^A silently collapses the uncontrolled inner limit into the controlled outer one. That collapse is invalid in general: an eventually constant computable sequence has no computable stabilization time, and no diagonal choice Gamma_{g(n),n} provably converges to Xi (for any computable g the pre-stabilization values can be arranged to persist at every diagonal point).

failure_location.quote: Finally, if we can fully control the limit in \eqref{limit_well-behaved}, then $\{\Xi,\Omega,\mathbb{R},\Lambda\}\in\Delta_2^A$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the sentence by the supported statement that the problem lies in Delta_3^A with error control on the final limit (a height-two tower); if the inner cover limit is also error-controlled, then Delta_1^A follows by the same argument as in thm_warm_up.
issues.overall_effect: Confined to the final sentence of thm_warm_up2: the fully controlled case under (S2) is not used by cor_assumII_extra_lims, fractal_dim_final, Table SCI_tab, or the applications, so nothing else inherits the error.
issues.title: Fully controlled case under (S2) still requires two limits (Delta_3^A, not Delta_2^A)
issues.why_classification: The correction necessarily weakens the asserted classification by one limit, so the claim itself is not preserved and the issue exceeds a minor fix; but the sentence is peripheral with no dependents and the remainder of the theorem and paper are intact, so the loss is limited and requires no new architecture.
